function_v0.doc:
The reserve's current dToken debt index (`d_rate`, `SCALAR_12` scale),
read live from Blend via `get_reserve`.

This is a live read, not a settled one: `get_reserve` runs `Reserve::load`,
which accrues from `data.last_time` to the current ledger timestamp before
returning (early-returning only when the reserve was already accrued this
ledger). So the index advances continuously on a quiet reserve, and a
`pin_index` at a term boundary captures that boundary's true index \xe2\x80\x94
no interaction has to land nearby.

`d_rate` does legitimately hold flat while nothing is borrowed from the
reserve \xe2\x80\x94 no debt, no interest. That is a real zero rate, not staleness.
function_v0.name: index

function_v0.doc: Replace the contract's wasm (admin-gated). Address and storage are kept.
function_v0.name: upgrade

function_v0.doc:
Hand the admin role to `new_admin` (current admin only).

`upgrade` is admin-gated and this contract has no other way to move that role, so without
this the deploying key kept un-timelocked code-replacement authority over it forever \xe2\x80\x94 the
governance handover could rotate the engine, vAMM and broker but not this.
function_v0.name: set_admin
